name: Oshio Kentarou
source:
A second year student of Sugatani Senior High School and a victim of Heavenly Host.

Unlike most victims of Heavenly Host Elementary School who did the Sachiko Ever After charm, Kentaro ended up in Heavenly Host Elementary School after performing the Holy Shroud's Promise charm.

Likes: Chewy rice balls
Dislikes: Spicy foods and stimulants
Hobbies: Gardening

From [url=https://corpseparty.fandom.com/wiki/Kentaro_Oshio]Corpse Party Wiki[/url]
